events.title: INSW to Report Q1 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
events.body: International Seaways heads into Q1 earnings with soaring estimates and strong revenue growth, but rising costs and geopolitical risks cloud the outlook.

events.title: Allegiant Q1 Earnings & Revenues Surpass Estimates, Improve Y/Y
events.body: ALGT tops Q1 EPS and revenue estimates as passenger sales rose 8.9% and load factor hit 84.4%, and Q2 ASM is forecasted to decrease 6.5%.

events.title: EXPD Q1 Earnings & Revenues Top Estimates on Airfreight Strength
events.body: EXPD beat Q1 estimates as airfreight tonnage rose 5%, margins improved despite late-quarter disruption.

events.body: Pilot chief calls it bold but stops short
